finalText:
All 13 AA918 reservations are rebooked, the vouchers are issued, and each passenger got one message after their booking. No fees were charged and no refunds were made. I re-checked the plan against the system before acting: AA918 was cancelled, there were no bulletins or open requests, tiers were unchanged and seat counts matched. Today is 2026-10-06 but the flight date was 2026-08-03. The reservations were still confirmed on AA918 with no re-protection history, so I treated the work as outstanding.

| Reservation | New itinerary | Vouchers |
|---|---|---|
| R6103 Chloe | UA88 business | none |
| R6109 Iris | UA88, moved up one cabin to premium economy | none |
| R6110 Jun and R6111 Kofi (group G-7) | AA204 economy, booked together | none |
| R6102 Ben | DL512 economy | 15000 compensation |
| R6106 Farid | UA88 basic economy | none |
| R6112 Lea | AA204, moved up one cabin to business | none |
| R6104 Dev | AA210 economy, then AA1410 ORD→BOS on 08-04 | 30000 compensation, 18000 hotel |
| R6113 Mo | AA210 economy, then AA1410 ORD→BOS on 08-04 | 30000 compensation, 18000 hotel |
| R6108 Hugo | AA210 economy | 30000 compensation |
| R6107 Grace | AA206 on 08-04, economy | 24000 compensation (capped at her fare), 18000 hotel |
| R6101 Ana | AA206 on 08-04, economy | 30000 compensation, 18000 hotel |
| R6105 Elena | AA204 basic economy | none |

- **Order and groups:** I booked in priority order (tier, then booking date). G-7 was handled at Kofi's gold priority and kept together in economy.
- **Upgrades:** Iris and Lea were the only upgrades. Each is a gold or platinum passenger travelling alone whose own cabin was full on a flight that gets them to Chicago sooner than any open seat in their own cabin. Each moved up one cabin only, and their messages explain why.
- **Dev and Mo:** AA1402 no longer connects after their new SFO flights, so I rebooked their onward leg onto AA1410 the next morning.
- **Hotel vouchers:** Only Dev, Mo, Grace and Ana reach their destination on a later date. Hugo arrives late on the original date, so he gets no hotel voucher.
